scripts.generate: node lighting/scripts/generate.mjs && node lighting/scripts/generate-ha.mjs && node lighting/scripts/generate-groups.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions --strict --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --resolveJsonModule --lib es2022,dom card/src/card.ts ui/src/index.ts
scripts.test: node lighting/scripts/generate.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-themes.mjs --check && node --test lighting/test/*.test.mjs test/*.test.mjs
scripts.docs:build: cd docs && bundle exec middleman build
